mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential mobility indicates a population-wide shift towards staying home, directly reducing discretionary out-of-home activities like retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to rise or remains high, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp recent decline in parks mobility suggests a broader reduction in outdoor and leisure activities, which will subsequently depress retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks as people avoid public spaces.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If PARKS mobility drops significantly, but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days shows an increase compared to the previous 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low levels in both workplace and transit station mobility indicate a persistent reduction in daily commuting and associated out-of-home activities, leading to lower retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain low, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The recent increase in residential mobility coupled with declines in other categories suggests a potential or anticipated tightening of local restrictions, which will directly suppress retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises while RETAIL_REC falls week-on-week
failure_condition: If residential mobility increases and retail mobility decreases, but no new restrictions are announced and RETAIL_REC subsequently rises.

mechanism_narrative: A recent decline in grocery and pharmacy visits indicates reduced essential movement, signaling a broader trend of decreased out-of-home activity that will negatively impact retail and recreation mobility over the next week.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM mobility declines, but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than the average of the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: When retail and recreation mobility drops below a critical threshold, it creates a negative feedback loop where fewer people visiting these places further discourages others, leading to continued decline over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC falls below -10% but then recovers and rises over the subsequent 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous sharp decline in parks visits and an increase in residential mobility indicates a strong shift towards staying indoors, which will collectively reduce all forms of out-of-home leisure, including retail and recreation, over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by >10 points and RESIDENTIAL rises by >0.5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If PARKS decline and RESIDENTIAL rises, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent low levels of transit and workplace mobility reflect a population that is highly cautious and avoiding non-essential travel and social interaction, which will keep retail and recreation mobility suppressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below -25% and -5% respectively for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain low, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days shows a significant upward trend.
